newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis slips, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis slips, wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis values were slightly weaker on Thursday with dealers citing the absence of anticipated demand from Spain.
"I think there is disappointment that Spain didn't come in and do some cargoes today," one corn export source said.

Hard red winter wheat values were steady, underpinned by news that Egypt had bought 110,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat for June shipment. Most expected U.S. hard red winter wheat to be delviered. There was also talk that Mexican buyers were seeking prices for U.S. HRW wheat supplies.
Soybean basis values were little changed.
